g.text: Local tables show full columns. Orange boxes are cross-domain references defined in another slice.

g.title: Full definition: project governance tables are documented with Admin/Project data.

PK: id Unique: uq_portal_storage_space_metadata_account_bucket(account_id, bucket_name) Check: ck_portal_storage_space_metadata_account_member_role: account_member_role IS NULL OR account_member_role IN ('Viewer', 'Editor'); ck_portal_storage_space_metadata_share_scope: share_scope IN ('restricted', 'account') Indexes: ix_portal_storage_space_metadata_account(account_id) [index]; ix_portal_storage_space_metadata_id(id) [index]

PK: id Unique: uq_portal_storage_space_grants_space_user(storage_space_metadata_id, user_id) Check: ck_portal_storage_space_grants_role: role IN ('Viewer', 'Editor', 'Owner') Indexes: ix_portal_storage_space_grants_id(id) [index]; ix_portal_storage_space_grants_space(storage_space_metadata_id) [index]; ix_portal_storage_space_grants_user(user_id) [index]

PK: id Unique: uq_portal_public_links_token(token) Indexes: ix_portal_public_links_account_bucket(account_id, bucket_name) [index]; ix_portal_public_links_expires(expires_at) [index]; ix_portal_public_links_id(id) [index]

PK: id Unique: uq_project_iam_user_scope(user_id, project_id, zonegroup_key) Indexes: ix_project_iam_users_authority_account(authority_account_id) [index]; ix_project_iam_users_id(id) [index]; ix_project_iam_users_project_user(project_id, user_id) [index]
